block_decomposition.field: Z_N(x)=sum_(B in P_N)<a_B(x),X_B> in a real uniformly bounded trigonometric basis, with independent centered centrally symmetric standardized blocks X_B.
block_decomposition.third_moment: Central symmetry makes mu3(x)=0 at every point.
block_decomposition.pointwise_identity: mu4(x)-3v(x)^2=sum_B kappa4(<a_B(x),X_B>) by additivity of joint cumulants over independent blocks.
block_decomposition.scope_guard: Stationarity is an explicit class premise; arbitrary independent real sine/cosine coordinates need not be stationary, and the identity supplies no sign or unrestricted coercivity.
